news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.14 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (up from ₹0.14 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹59.2m (up 54% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹534.0k (up ₹2.14m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 0.9% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 109 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
